text: The program includes the conversion of five national seismic stations to broadband, establishment of a National Multi-Hazard Early Warning Centre, development of a national school building infrastructure policy, rollout of a fire safety curriculum, and creation of an integrated data system for disability and elderly populations. It emphasizes strong national governance through a steering committee and regional technical support.

metadata.solution_name: Building Safety and Resilience in the Pacific Phase II – Papua New Guinea Country Program (BSRP II – PNG)
